decisions.reason: Requiring supporting links in submitted task artifacts does not change the existing assignment deadlines or completion schedule.
The artifact-link requirement does not alter the fallback behavior for independently selecting work when an assignment is unavailable.
Including links in task artifacts does not change the requirement to mark completed tasks in ClickUp.
The source does not specifically identify the CRM structure document or necessarily require supporting links within that particular deliverable.
Supporting links in completed task artifacts are unrelated to visibility of shared credentials through Bitwarden.
